TRIP-ANGKOR / THE JOURNEY
More than a game

One community.
Endless journeys.

TRIP-ANGKOR brings together people who love motorcycles, custom rides, scenic routes and playing together. Meet your crew, explore new places and make every session a new adventure.

Build your own style, discover the map and enjoy the journey with the Trip Online Server community.

Quick answers

Good to know.

Important details for anyone visiting the TRIP-ANGKOR website.

What is TRIP-ANGKOR?

TRIP-ANGKOR is a community gaming website concept for motorcycle lovers, custom rides, virtual trips and players who want to connect.

Where can I download the game?

The download button is a placeholder for now. Use the official community links for verified release news; do not install files from unknown mirrors.

What modes are shown on this site?

SOLO TRIP, DUO TRIP and SQUAD TRIP, presented as Trip Online Server modes. Actual availability depends on the game/server release.

Can I replace the gallery pictures?

Yes. Replace the image URLs in the HTML with URLs for your own screenshots or images you have permission to use. The page will remain a single HTML file.
